text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application by the owner(s) of 20 Fisher Street to maintain a wooden fence with a height of 2.3 meters (7.5 feet) in the rear yard on the East property. The fence has a length of approximately 5 meters and is abutting 22 Fisher Street. The fence would be in contravention of the Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447-1.2B (1) Table 1 – Maximum Height of Fences.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Granted the application for an exemption permit, by the owner(s) of 20 Fisher Street, to allow them to maintain the wooden fence with a height of 2.3 meters (7.5 feet) in the rear yard on the East property. Directed and required that the existing fence be maintained in good repair without alteration. Directed and required that at such time as a replacement of the fence is required that such installation will comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447-Fences, or its successor by-law.
